headline: New Products Fortify Earnings Visibility

highlights: Daily Volume 7,31,713 Q2FY27: Strong revenue performance, EBITDA margin lower than estimate ▪ Revenue was up 47.6% YoY and 14.5% QoQ to INR 15,552 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 13,308 Mn) ▪ EBITDA was up 30.2% YoY and 11.2% QoQ to INR 1,786 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 1,647 Mn).
Excluding the pass-through impact of higher aluminium price and strategic reduction in wheel assembly business, net revenue grew 29.5% YoY, outperforming 2W average industry growth.
EBITDA margin stood at 11.5%, down by 153 bps YoY, while PAT increased 27.3% YoY.

HPDC alloy wheels and capacity expansion boost growth visibility: Commercial supplies of HPDC alloy wheels commenced in August 2026 to a leading Japanese OEM, with expected revenue of INR 800 Mn in FY27E and orders worth INR 2,400 Mn for FY28E.
valuation: View and Valuation: We raise our FY27/28E EPS estimate by ~8%/3%, respectively, factoring in better-than-expected Q2FY27 performance, premiumisation and rising content per vehicle.
We retain our target price of INR 730 and maintain our ‘BUY’ rating, backed by a strong growth visibility, EV opportunities and new product ramp-up. 1 Choice Equity Broking Pvt.
watch: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW became operational in October 2026 Margin & long-term outlook ▪ The management expects EBITDA margins to remain stable or improve marginally in H2FY27.
